clean_repro.observed: HTTP 200, {"code":0,"data":{}} — drop on nonexistent collection returns success instead of 404

contract_refs: structured_contract.json endpoint 'collections+drop': '404 if collection does not exist; Drop is irreversible'
contract_grounding.assertion_text: HTTP 404 if collection does not exist

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: HTTP POST /collections/drop → handler_v2.dropCollection → proxy.DropCollection(ctx, req) → rootcoord.DropCollectionTask → no explicit collection existence check → returns success even for nonexistent collection
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现:HTTP handler (handler_v2.go) 与底层逻辑 (rootcoord/drop_collection_task.go) 均未在 drop 前检查 collection 是否存在。contract 声明应返回 404,但源码无此校验 → 真缺陷(Type1_IllegalSuccess:DROP 作用于不存在的资源返回成功而非 404)

falsification.observed: HTTP 200, {"code":0,"data":{"value":false}} — collection does not exist, yet drop returned success. This contradicts expected idempotency (DROP on nonexistent should be error, not success).

cognition_match.note: 未命中 by_design/rejection_patterns。REST v2 API 盲点之一(developer_cognition.json: 'REST v2 API data type serialization - 8 issues in corpus'),但此 case 为行为缺失校验非数据类型问题

contract.explicit_requirement: 404 if collection does not exist (contract endpoint: collections+drop)

physical.objective_constraint: Dropping a nonexistent resource is physically meaningless — should fail fast

verdicts.rationale: Milvus REST v2 /collections/drop 对不存在的 collection 返回 HTTP 200 + code:0(成功)而非 contract 声明的 HTTP 404。源码接地显示 HTTP 层(handler_v2.go)与底层逻辑(rootcoord/drop_collection_task.go)均未在 drop 前检查 collection 存在性。证伪实验证明目标 collection 确实不存在(/has 返回 false),但 drop 仍返回成功。这违反了 contract 明文规定('404 if collection does not exist')且违反物理约束(DROP 不存在的资源应失败)。开发者认知未显示此为 by-design 模式。
